collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager who dances beautifully alone is offered a hand into the festival circle: take the hand, or stay at the edge.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) loves dancing. Alone, in (subject.his/her) hut, (subject.he/she) is a wonderful dancer. At festivals (subject.he/she) stands at the edge and taps one foot and never once goes into the circle. Tonight the drums are going, the circle is full, and (friend) is holding out a hand.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) takes it. For the first few steps (subject.he/she) is stiff with shyness. Then the drums get into (subject.his/her) feet, and (subject.he/she) forgets to be stiff, and dances, properly, for the first time in front of anyone. Afterwards (subject.he/she) is not sure who that was. (subject.He/she) would like to be that person again.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "Not tonight," says (subject), smiling. "But thank you." (friend) shrugs and dances off. (subject) stays at the edge, tapping (subject.his/her) foot, enjoying the music. Later, alone in (subject.his/her) hut, (subject.he/she) dances every dance (subject.he/she) saw tonight. Nobody sees. That's alright. The dancing is for (subject.him/her).
